author: Yffe
content: Failing tests at thermite-lower/tests/divergence_spec_call_cast_proof_aid_paths.rs demonstrate two divergences against verus-lowering.md REQ-5 (#225 declared-param-type rule), contradicting 1c59e4fd's 'ALL six spec-context entry points' claim: (1) nonlinear_overflow_assert re-lowers the fn req as a by(nonlinear_arith) requires hypothesis via bare Ctx::spec_seq() — a u32-param spec-call arith arg emits s_dec((k + 0) as u64) while the SAME req lowers as u32 in the signature/invariant two lines above; live forge check: item dies at L0 via E0308 though the source is correct (the exact #227 class). (2) lower_inv_expr routes a struct-inv Expr::Call through its catch-all lower_expr(.., Ctx::spec_seq(), ..) — emits s_dec((x + 0) as u64) AND drops the REQ-8 self.<field> rewrite (bare x, unresolvable). Same-class unthreaded sites flagged for the fixer (not individually pinned): find_product_bound's bound-factor lowering, find_none_forall_in/match_bounded_combinator pred lowering (complementary_coverage_split aids), seq_fold_body's base arm, lower_index_arg in lower_inv_expr, and lower_equivalence_obligation's req (conservative-only: the obligation omits spec-fn defs so a spec-call req can never verify; survivor stays counted).
